package.name: rosbag2_dynamic_recorder_interfaces
package.description:
Interface definitions for runtime topic management on a rosbag2 recorder: services to subscribe, unsubscribe and replace the recorded topic set, plus a SubscriptionChangeEvent recorded into the bag so that a topic which stops mid-bag is distinguishable from lost data.
Field naming and the return_code convention deliberately follow the style of the existing rosbag2_interfaces services, so these read as a natural extension of them.
GetSubscribedTopics is defined here rather than reused from rosbag2_interfaces because the upstream one exists only on the rolling branch, not in any release, so depending on it forced a full source build of rosbag2 on every user. The definition is field-identical.
